tprs-tuffsafe.intro: TPRS Tuffsafe is a range of thermally treated glass created to provide enhanced strength and safety for a broad spectrum of use cases. It is classified into two types: heat-strengthened glass, which is far more resistant to impact stress and temperature fluctuations, and toughened glass, which is meant to be exceptionally durable and, if crushed, fragments shatter into small, harmless shards, thus maximizing safety. With TPRS Tuffsafe, you get reliable, high-performance glass that combines durability and safety.

highlights.title: Toughened Glass
highlights.content: Heated and then cooled very suddenly and rapidly using powerful air jets. This "shock" freezes the outer surface instantly while the core cools later, creating immense tension. This is what gives it 4-5x strength and causes it to shatter into tiny harmless crumbs.

highlights.title: Heat-Strengthened Glass
highlights.content: Heated and then cooled gradually. It is not just left in normal temperature; it is still forced-cooled, just much gentler. The slower cooling creates less tension. It is approx 2x stronger than normal glass. Because the tension isn't as high, if it breaks, it forms large shards.

highlights.title: Bevelling
highlights.content: Precision double edge shaping with advanced bevelling machines to deliver clean, consistent angles for a premium look.

highlights.title: Polishing
highlights.content: High-grade automated polishing machines ensure flawless, glossy edges with unmatched clarity and finish.

highlights.title: Drilling
highlights.content: CNC-controlled drilling provides accurate, chip-free holes with smooth edges for fittings and fixtures.

highlights.title: Cutouts with waterjet
highlights.content: State-of-the-art waterjet technology enables intricate, stress-free cutouts with superior edge quality.

highlights.title: Heat Soaking Process
highlights.content: Spontaneous breaking of glass in facades — this is due to Nickel Sulfide (NiS) inclusions in the glass. To avoid this, there is a recognized process called the Heat Soaking Process, in which the glass is placed in a heat soaking chamber and the temperature is raised to approximately 290°C (550°F) for a few hours. This process accelerates the expansion of Nickel Sulfide (NiS) inclusions, causing any glass containing these inclusions to shatter within the chamber. This reduces the likelihood of the glass breaking unexpectedly after installation.

faqs.title: What is TPRS Glass known for in the glass processing industry?
faqs.content: TPRS Glass is a leading glass processing company in India, specializing in toughened glass, heat-strengthened glass, laminated glass, curved glass, and architectural glazing solutions.

faqs.title: What does the brand TPRS Tuffsafe represent?
faqs.content: TPRS Tuffsafe is one of the key solutions offered by TPRS Glass, specializing in high-performance toughened and heat-strengthened safety glass designed for both residential and commercial applications.

faqs.title: What is toughened glass?
faqs.content: Toughened glass (also known as tempered glass) is a type of safety glass processed by controlled thermal treatments to increase strength and resistance.

faqs.title: What industries does TPRS Glass serve?
faqs.content: TPRS Glass serves the Architectural, Automotive, Locomotive, Vertical Mobility, Earthmovers, Refrigeration, and industrial sectors with durable and aesthetic glass solutions.

faqs.title: What makes TPRS Tuffsafe glass different from ordinary glass?
faqs.content: TPRS Tuffsafe glass undergoes controlled heat treatment, making it 4–5 times stronger than normal glass and highly resistant to thermal stress and impact.

faqs.title: What is heat-strengthened glass?
faqs.content: Heat-strengthened glass (HS glass) is produced by heating and slowly cooling glass to increase its strength, making it about twice as strong as annealed glass while retaining good clarity.

tprs-lamisafe.name: TPRS Lamisafe
tprs-lamisafe.subtitle: Laminated Glass for Impact Resistance and Durability

Our advanced lamination capabilities include utilizing PVB, SGP, or EVA interlayers in double or multi-layer formats to meet various structural and aesthetic demands. TPRS Lamisafe features upgraded technology, which includes dust-free clean rooms and automated interlayer processing, ensuring outstanding quality and clarity.

highlights.title: Mesh Lamination

Your choice can be tailored to the colors, designs, patterns, textures, levels of light transmission required etc. This also helps you save floor space and keep your space safe and low maintenance by avoiding curtains.

highlights.title: Step Lamination

highlights.title: Wizard Glass

highlights.title: Printed Lamination

highlights.title: Laminated DGU

highlights.title: Multi-Lamination
highlights.content: Multiple interlayers enhance strength, safety, and structural performance

highlights.title: Color Lamination
highlights.content: Colored interlayers create vibrant, durable glass with safety and expressive design.

highlights.title: Fire-rated Glass
highlights.content: Transparency that resists the heat. Fire-rated Glass from TPRS offers advanced protection without compromising visibility or design. Engineered with E, EW, and EI classifications, it ensures integrity, smoke resistance, and thermal insulation for 30 to 120 minutes. Built for modern architectural safety standards, it delivers reliable fire resistance while maintaining aesthetic transparency. It also safeguards people, property, and performance in every environment.

highlights.title: Special Interlayer Glass
highlights.content: Innovative textures and finishes that enhance any space. The Special Interlayer Glass collection from TPRS blends artistry with functionality, offering designs like waves, ripples, and subtle stripes that enhance visual appeal and sophistication. Each glass features unique textures and luminous finishes, creating depth and elegance. With its wide range of aesthetic choices and premium finish, Signature Collection Glass adds a refined, modern touch to every environment.

Innovink uses durable ceramic inks to create precision-printed patterns, textures, and photorealistic graphics, making use of innovative digital and screen printing technologies such as the globally renowned DIP-TECH GPI series. Beyond aesthetics, it adds functional benefits like thermal control, glare reduction, and shade efficiency. With a curated range of eco-conscious inks, TPRS Innovink turns glass into a creative and functional design element.

highlights.content: CNC-driven digital printing brings photorealistic images, vectors, and art onto glass with heat-processed durability.

highlights.title: Ceramic Screen Printing

faqs.title: What is TPRS Innovink?
faqs.content: TPRS Innovink is an advanced glass printing technology that combines ceramic digital printing, ceramic screen printing, UV printing, and lacquer coating for both functional and decorative applications.

faqs.title: What makes TPRS Innovink unique?

faqs.title: What equipment is used in TPRS Innovink printing?

faqs.title: What is the difference between ceramic and UV printing?
faqs.content: Ceramic printing uses heat-fused inks that create a durable, weather-resistant finish suitable for long-term use. UV printing delivers vivid colour and a smooth finish, making it best suited for visually rich indoor applications.

faqs.title: What is TPRS Innovink Lacquered Glass?
faqs.content: Back-painted glass with a sleek finish for wardrobes, wall panels, and kitchens.

faqs.title: What is Wizardglass (Switchable Glass)?
faqs.content: Wizardglass is TPRS's innovative switchable glass technology using Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystal (PDLC) that allows instant control over transparency. The glass switches from clear to opaque with electrical activation, providing on-demand privacy and light control.

faqs.title: How does TPRS Wizardglass work?
faqs.content: When an electric current (35–70 VAC) passes through the PDLC film, the liquid crystals align, making the glass transparent. When switched off, the crystals scatter light, turning the glass opaque.

faqs.title: What is the difference between PDLC laminated glass and retrofit film?
faqs.content: Laminated glass integrates the PDLC film between two glass layers during manufacturing, offering durability and safety. Retrofit uses a film sticker applied on existing glass, suitable for quick upgrades.

faqs.title: What voltage does it require to operate?
faqs.content: It operates on a low-voltage AC supply of 35–70 VAC via a dedicated controller.

tprs-winsafe.name: TPRS Winsafe
tprs-winsafe.subtitle: Safeguarding spaces with precision engineering and lasting reliability
tprs-winsafe.intro: TPRS Winsafe frames are built with a robust aluminum profile, ensuring both strength and a sleek appearance. The manufacturing process utilizes a hydraulic press for precise metal bending and a CNC milling machine to accurately cut and shape each component. Advanced TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas) welding techniques are employed for seamless and durable joints. For enhanced protection and performance, EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Rubber) is used, providing reliable weatherproofing, vibration dampening, and UV resistance.

highlights.title: Sliding Frames
highlights.content: Smooth operable sliding ensured by precise fabrication and EPDM sealing for comfort and durability.

highlights.title: Fixed Frames
highlights.content: Non-operable frames engineered for maximum visibility while maintaining structural reliability.

highlights.title: Regular Frames (AC and Non-AC)
highlights.content: Standard framed windows engineered for both air-conditioned and non-AC buses, balancing ventilation, safety, and aesthetics.

specs.title: Process type
specs.content: Window frames are fabricated by cutting and machining profiles, assembling them with joints and gaskets, and glazing glass with sealants to achieve a secure, functional, and long-lasting finish.

faqs.title: What materials are used in TPRS Winsafe window frames?
faqs.content: We use high-grade aluminium profiles, EPDM rubber sealing, precision-machined components, and high-quality glazing materials.

faqs.title: What is the maximum size available for your window frames?

faqs.title: Do you provide sliding window frames for buses and trains?
faqs.content: Yes, we offer smooth operable sliding frames with precise fabrication and EPDM sealing for easy operation and long-term performance.

faqs.title: Do you manufacture window frames for AC buses?
faqs.content: Yes. We offer AC-compatible framed windows engineered to support insulation and reduced air leakage.
